name: Tachibana Shizuka
source: A beautiful girl with good looks and a plump figure. She was raised to be ojou, and is somewhat naive. She is active in modeling, singing, and drama, and is a honor student with a very polite speech pattern. Despite this, she is a bit of a ditz who lacks common sense. After being trained by the protagonist, she loves rough sex and becomes a slut.
